Frequently Asked Questions

How narrow should an entryway organizer be for a small apartment?

Aim for 7 to 10 inches deep so you keep at least 32 to 36 inches of clear walking path through the doorway.

What if my apartment front door is wood instead of metal?

Use a padded over-the-door hook rack or removable Command-strip key shelf instead of magnetic holders.
